error[ZBX-E0811]: a Dockerfile instruction or flag is not supported
  while  importing Dockerfile
  cause  Dockerfile:3 has FROM --platform=linux/arm64, but zbx builds only for
         the host, linux/amd64
  line   3
  fix    write --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM, or remove the flag
  more   zbx explain E0811
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0811.html
